title: Berlin B-Plan (Bebauungsplan) WFS — plan LOCATOR adapter
authority: Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin (GDI-BE / FIS-Broker)
CRITICAL_locatorNotRuleTable: ⚠ This WFS is a plan LOCATOR, NOT a rule table. GRZ / GFZ / Vollgeschosse / height / Baugrenze are NOT present as attributes in the B-Plan WFS schema. They live ONLY in the linked Satzung PDF (the legal plan document). Therefore farRatio, maxHeight_m, maxFloors, maxCoverage and setbacks MUST stay `unknown` and are NEVER populated from GIS/WFS metadata — only from extracted, human-verified, cited plan text attached to the exact planid. See gis/bplan-document.json and gis/bplan-parser.json for the extraction bridge.
